steps.en: The contact check runs for defendants with unpaid court summonses
steps.id: Cek kontak jalan untuk defendant court summons yang belum bayar
steps.why_en: The check runs only on parking reminder records, not court summons.
steps.why_id: Cek hanya jalan untuk record reminder parking, bukan court summons.

steps.en: OCMS checks the latest mobile number and email
steps.id: OCMS memeriksa nomor mobile dan email terbaru
steps.why_en: The lookup exists but is switched off in the prod config; source unconfirmed.
steps.why_id: Lookup ada tapi dimatikan di konfigurasi prod; sumber belum bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: A defendant without valid contact gets no reminder
steps.id: Defendant tanpa kontak valid tidak dikirimi reminder
steps.why_en: Skipping works, but only for parking reminders.
steps.why_id: Skip berjalan, tapi hanya untuk reminder parking.

steps.en: OCMS sends electronic reminders for outstanding court summonses
steps.id: OCMS mengirim reminder elektronik untuk court summons outstanding
steps.why_en: No court summons reminder content or path exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada konten atau jalur reminder court summons.
